$comment: Single source of feature toggles. Read by Rust (include_str! in src-tauri/src/config.rs) and by the frontend (vite define -> __STARTER_CONFIG__). App name/identifier/version live in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json; run `npm run configure` to set everything at once.

permissions.$comment: Permissions the health check reports. `required` ones block onboarding until granted; `optional` ones are shown but never block. Values: notifications, accessibility, screen_recording, microphone, camera, input_monitoring.

telemetry.$comment: Telemetry is OPT-IN: nothing is sent until the user enables it in Settings. Sinks with empty endpoints/DSNs are skipped. The file sink always writes local logs.
